title: ui-confirm: compose ProblemConfirm component
description: Create the ProblemConfirm composite component that orchestrates the confirm phase UI by combining ProblemDisplay, AntithesisInput, AntithesisQuality, and action buttons. This component manages the layout and interaction flow for users to validate and confirm their problem definitions.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL display all child components in a cohesive layout
THE SYSTEM SHALL provide clear confirmation and rejection actions

event_driven.trigger: WHEN the confirm phase is entered
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL initialize all child components with current problem context

event_driven.trigger: WHEN user clicks the confirm button
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL validate all inputs and proceed to the next phase

event_driven.trigger: WHEN user clicks the reject button
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL return to the previous phase with the problem marked for revision

unwanted.condition: IF required child components fail to load
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT render an incomplete or broken layout
unwanted.because: partial UI breaks user experience and confuses navigation

unwanted.condition: IF the user attempts to confirm without completing required fields
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow progression without validation
unwanted.because: incomplete confirmations undermine the problem validation process

preconditions: Problem context must be fully loaded and available
User must have appropriate permissions for the confirm action
postconditions: On confirmation, problem status is updated to confirmed
On rejection, problem returns to refinement with feedback
invariants: Navigation actions are always available (confirm, reject, back)
Component state is preserved across re-renders within the same session

happy: Given a valid problem and antithesis, when user clicks confirm, then problem status updates and navigation proceeds
Given the confirm phase is active, when rendered, then all child components display correctly in proper layout
Given user input changes, when displayed, then child components update reactively
error: Given a missing problem context, when rendered, then displays appropriate error message with recovery options
Given a child component failure, when rendered, then gracefully degrades with fallback UI
Given a validation failure on confirm, when user attempts to proceed, then displays specific validation errors

phase_0: Check layout patterns for confirm phase
phase_2: Create ProblemConfirm component combining all child components

similar: See existing composite components for layout patterns
